title: Normalize `mean_on_target` by sample weights in regression evaluation
body: ### Related Issues/PRs None. ### What changes are proposed in this pull request? The regression evaluator divides its weighted target sum by the row count. Multiplying all sample weights therefore changes `mean_on_target`: targets `[2, 4, 8]` with weights `[10, 30, 0]` produce `46.6667` instead of `3.5`. Use the weighted average for `mean_on_target`. Keep `sum_on_target` as the weighted total and `example_count` as the row count. Correct the existing weighted golden from `-5.2 / 3` to `-5.2 / 6`. ### How is this PR tested? - [x] New unit/integration tests Base: `e8a158349ec5ce27f715b8b1dd4a92dd7d409b8a`. Seven new cases produce **5 failed, 2 passed** on unchanged master and **7 passed** with the fix. They cover unweighted/uniform-weight controls, fractional and rescaled weights, zero-weight observations, frequency weights versus repeated observations, and a real `mlflow.models.evaluate` call followed by reading persisted run metrics. `PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest tests/evaluate/test_regressor_target_statistics.py -q -p pytest_mock -p pytest_timeout`: **7 passed**. Pinned Ruff 0.16.8, formatting, Clint, character normalization and `git diff --check` pass. Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.5.4 and scikit-learn 1.7.2 were used. The existing `test_default_evaluator.py` module was attempted with `-k test_get_regressor_metrics`, but collection is blocked by its unconditional `pyspark` import; the corrected legacy golden is not counted as a passing test. The new integration test runs without Spark. Full-repository tests were not run. Full pre-commit is blocked while initializing the unrelated Prettier environment by npm `EALLOWGIT`; the Python checks were run separately with pinned tools. ### Does this PR require documentation update? - [x] No. ### Does this PR require updating the [MLflow Skills](https://github.com/mlflow/skills) repository? - [x] No. ### Release Notes #### Is this a user-facing change? - [x] Yes. Regression evaluation correctly normalizes `mean_on_target` when sample weights are supplied. #### What component(s), interfaces, languages, and integrations does this PR affect? Components - [x] `area/evaluation`: MLflow model evaluation features, evaluation metrics, and evaluation workflows #### How should the PR be classified in the release notes? Choose one: - [x] `rn/bug-fix` - A user-facing bug fix worth mentioning in the release notes #### Is this PR a critical bugfix or security fix that should go into the next patch release? - [ ] This PR is critical and needs to be in the next patch release - [x] This PR can wait for the next minor release
